R-96 Nasal Spray (Preservative Free)
 
Breathe Easy with Dr.Reckeweg’s R-96 Nasal Spray. Non-irritating & Preservative Free !!!

With increased particulate and pollution levels in our cities, Adults and children frequently struggle with breathing difficulties, persistent cough, allergies, asthma etc while the elderly are prone to pneumonia. This product is recommended as a nasal decongestant when you have a blocked nose, making breathing difficult. Also suitable for Children as contains NO preservatives.

 
USEFUL FOR:

Nasal Congestion
Allergic Rhinitis
Sinusitis
Cold
Snoring
Sneezing
Running Nose
Inflammation of Nasal mucosa

Directions for use: Can be used by all ages, as Preservative free.
Infants (2-5 yrs)       : 1 pump stroke, 2-3 times daily.
Children (6-12 yrs)  : 1 pump stroke, 3-4 times daily.
Adult                       : 1 pump stroke, 3-4 times daily.
 
COMPOSITION :  Calcium carbonicum Hah D12, Cinnabaris D8, Kali bichromicum D6, Pulsatilla D6.
 
Instant Action and Quick Relief
